checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-done.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" done --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'ao done <bead-id> [flags]' "$tmp/help"; for flag in force-no-verdict json reason sha; do grep -Fq -- "--$flag" "$tmp/help"; done; set +e; "$tmp/ao" done age-test --sha bad >"$tmp/out" 2>"$tmp/err"; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -eq 1; grep -Fq 'is not a commit sha' "$tmp/err"

aliases.reason: The done family declares no aliases.
